People give the work direction and accountable review.

People express intentions, examine evidence and make decisions within their authority. Their reviews and accepted decisions become part of the continuing project state.

Agents recover context and act within a scope.

An agent works in a temporary session. It receives checked context and ontology views from project state, and acts only with applicable permission. Short-term memory belongs to the session.

Work turns an intention into an attempt you can examine.

Projects coordinate bounded work. An attempt produces records of what happened, including results and evidence. Those records support investigation, review and the next person or agent taking over.
